channel.title: The Hawley Record: News
channel.description: News and analysis on Sen. Josh Hawley's record.

item.title: Hawley blames Jack Smith for a search that happened before Smith had the job
item.description: On Fox News, Josh Hawley blamed Jack Smith for going through Melania Trump's drawers. The FBI search happened months before Smith was even appointed to the job.

item.title: Hawley’s Medicaid “fix” has sat untouched for 14 months
item.description: Josh Hawley filed a bill to undo the Medicaid cuts he voted for. Fourteen months later, S. 2279 has zero cosponsors and hasn't moved. What that says about it.

item.title: Hawley’s “Declaration for Life” takes his abortion fight national
item.description: Josh Hawley's "Declaration for Life" asks Congress to ban mifepristone, the abortion pill, nationwide. What it says, and what it means for Missouri voters.

item.title: Amendment 3, round two: Hawley wants Missouri to vote again on abortion
item.description: Missouri votes again on abortion November 3, 2026. What the new Amendment 3 would do, what polls show, and why Josh Hawley wants to overturn 2024's vote.
